design.name: 冰蚕·冻茧
design.brief: The ice silkworm's healing form, modelled separately: the larva wrapped in its frozen cocoon.
design.turnaround_lead: the ice silkworm wrapped inside its frozen healing cocoon
design.turnaround_pose: , lying on the ground: a fat elongated oval cocoon about 3 m long made of thick shining frost-silk wound around it as a few broad wrapped bands, pale moon-white with a cold blue sheen, the silkworm's two short black horns poking out at the front end, a faint inner light painted as opaque pale cyan patches between the bands (no halo, no particles)
design.turnaround_digits: The whole cocoon and both horns fully inside the frame; in the side views the long cocoon must fit inside the view with margin.
